_comment: Non-rotating identifiers for the Project Zomboid dedicated server.
Everything here is stable; nothing in this file needs re-pinning per build.
Deliberately absent: Steam depot manifestId + content hash. Those rotate on
every PZ build and cannot be committed honestly by hand — they belong in a
generated manifest produced by a fetcher (nix-community/steam-fetcher's
fetchSteam, which is NOT in nixpkgs). Until such a fetcher is wired up, the
server is fetched by steamcmd at activation time into `serverDir`, and
